reviews.title: Great game ruined by ads and slow progression.
reviews.text: The actual game is fun, but the progression is painfully slow. I’m constantly being pushed to watch ad after ad just to get enough resources for tiny upgrades. reviews.title: One of the Best Modern Mobile Games!
reviews.text: I genuinely never write reviews for games, but I enjoy this one so much! The power scaling is very fun to do especially at first, and the gameplay is engaging. The upgrade system can make the same level feel completely different depending on luck of the draw (which is a refreshing feature). There’s not really a pay-to-win aspect aside from unlocking all characters that are released (but you can do just fine without them). Each update seems to be improving the game instead of breaking it as many developers of similar projects seem to do. Compared to every other TWD game this is certainly number one on the mobile side. Only better experience you can get is Telltale and that’s not even a fair comparison. So overall I’m loving this game, and I look forward to seeing it expanded upon as a nearly day one player!

reviews.title: More Slop.
reviews.text:
I’ll never understand why all these games operate the same way. When you intentionally make a game miserable to play unless you pay money, you alienate 99% of players. 

Why not just prioritize FUN?? You will make more money this way. But prioritizing REVENUE results in the exact opposite desired effect. 

I hate this modern philosophy. This had all the potential to be a simple, fun game to play, and i probably would have spent a couple $ to support that attempt. But this isn’t even a “game” in all honesty, it’s just another shop&ad simulator broken up by morsels of gameplay.

Disappointing. It feels like a game created by accountants and shareholders.

reviews.title: Fun game, ads suck, not worth $10 a month for ad free!
reviews.text: Basically what the title says, in general the gameplay is fun. The ads for things like mission only skill modifiers for every 5 minute mission at 30 seconds a pop is ridiculous! Same thing for even smaller guild defend the wall mission which can last half as long, spending more time watching ads than actually playing. Huge time sync on an already grind heavy game. If it was a 1 time ad free purchase like many other games I would probably continue to play and spend elsewhere, but otherwise not worth it in my own opinion. Plus typical bugs and undesirable revamps in such a short time makes it even less desirable. Bummer.

reviews.title: Buggy, Non-responsive Ad farm
reviews.text:
Most time spent with this app open is watching adds. 

I was excited about and really wanted to enjoy this game, got into an active group and was doing the grind to level my roster of characters, but you quickly hit a wall that either requires money on constant repetitive grinding. Having encountered this in game before and being a fan of TWD, I tried to lock in for the grind and commit to see what the game had in store, deciding ultimately to hold out for my favorite character, Daryl. They finally added him in a limited event that requires a certain level of participation for chances at acquiring him and you can spend the game’s gem currency for extra chances. After saving up and waiting for the eventuality of this character, I participated and spent the majority of my gems on opportunities to acquire him and did not,    but not only did not receive the character but my progress bar for earning the special side currency used in the event shop wasn’t working and letting claim my rewards, and when I changed tabs in the game my progress REVERTED to before when I spent any gems and my gems were still missing. I immediately messaged in-game support about this issue, but was ignored and the event ended with no response. 

Ultimately felt like a huge let down and waste of time, especially after all the adds.

reviews.text:
The thing that sucked the most was the constant ads, but that I was OK with because I really liked the game. And then they just started updating it. Some things were good but it’s one of the things was how you combine the equipment. So it’s already hard enough to get the equipment so it was kind of nice that you’re able to combine whatever and get it going and they just made an Update to make it where you know you need the same pieces of equipment to combined with higher level Gear, which is incredibly difficult to get and takes Forever. I just got one piece the other day by combining two different pieces and I finally got the piece of equipment. I needed to do it for my helmet and now they done it this way, which is gonna take me forever to get there another piece of the same Gear.

So I’m quitting the game and I’m just not gonna put my energy in it because it’s already hard enough to get it. They have a game going on where you have to pay rubies to do pulls. And it stopped on the higher reward and a few seconds goes by where nothing happens then it ticks over and stops on a lesser reward. Which I had plenty of the ones with different lesser rewards and it never did that. 

It was a pretty decent game overall, but it really drives a paid to win type of thing behind it just like any of the other games I guess but this one’s kind of making you want to do that so I appreciate being able to enjoy the game for as long as I did which was not really that long.

reviews.title: No progression
reviews.text: Your game is quickly becoming dull.  I’m getting no progression. You make everything so hard to acquire as far as getting a new characters. I pay for your monthly membership.  It seems to give me nothing as far as progressing, even re-rolling skills all I get for defend the gates are dodge chance, health and mines. Which do nothing for defend the gates. I go from 900 points to 200 point. Which the rewards for defend the gate are so minimal anyways. Your game is so stagnant at this point.  Also, what’s the point on not letting me get more characters? You make it so freaking difficult to acquire new characters. I spent $50 to get the featured character after 35 tries was turned out to only have a 25% chance. I got a refund, but even Apple claimed that this was not very integral on your part. Let us acquire. We still have to upgrade them.  This game seems more like a money grab than you wanting to make a fun game.  Even playing rounds I have to spend 5+ minutes on a round that I’ve already beat, I should just be able to quit beat it using my energy. Especially since I’m paying $10 a month for your membership.  I’ve been stuck in the same spot in your game for two weeks.  You’ve come out with new characters yet I haven’t acquired any new characters after the first week.  I’ve played many of the Walking Dead games and yours is by far the worst!!!
